/tmp/r04-work/venv/bin/python -c 'exec("import hashlib,json,math
from pathlib import Path
gpu_root=Path('''/home/huyudi/013_spatial/remote_outputs/pilot_r2_k0_f0_gpu_20260831''')
cpu_root=Path('''/home/huyudi/013_spatial/remote_outputs/pilot_r2_k0_f0_cpu_20260831''')
gpu=json.loads((gpu_root/'''cell.json''').read_text())
cpu=json.loads((cpu_root/'''cell.json''').read_text())
rtol=1e-4; atol=1e-5; differences=[]; max_abs=0.0; max_rel=0.0
def check_map(name,a,b):
    global max_abs,max_rel
    if set(a)!=set(b): differences.append(name+''':keys'''); return
    for k in sorted(a):
        x=float(a[k]); y=float(b[k]); d=abs(x-y); rel=d/max(abs(y),1e-12); max_abs=max(max_abs,d); max_rel=max(max_rel,rel)
        if not math.isclose(x,y,rel_tol=rtol,abs_tol=atol): differences.append(name+''':'''+str(k))
if gpu.get('''k_model''')!=cpu.get('''k_model''') or gpu.get('''fold''')!=cpu.get('''fold'''): differences.append('''identity''')
for key in ('''status''','''inference_authority''','''strict_audit_status''','''selected_k'''):
    if gpu.get(key)!=cpu.get(key): differences.append(key)
check_map('''patient_scores''',gpu.get('''patient_scores''',{}),cpu.get('''patient_scores''',{}))
def section_map(cell): return {(x['''section_id'''],x['''gene_split''']):x['''score'''] for x in cell.get('''section_scores''',[])}
check_map('''section_scores''',section_map(gpu),section_map(cpu))
def traces(cell): return [d.get('''diagnostics''',{}).get('''loss_trace''',[]) for d in cell.get('''inference_diagnostics_by_split''',[])]
gt=traces(gpu); ct=traces(cpu)
if len(gt)!=len(ct) or any(len(x)!=len(y) for x,y in zip(gt,ct)): differences.append('''loss_trace_shape''')
else:
    for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(gt,ct)): check_map('''loss_trace_'''+str(i),{str(j):v for j,v in enumerate(x)},{str(j):v for j,v in enumerate(y)})
if gpu.get('''inference_platform''')!=cpu.get('''inference_platform'''): differences.append('''inference_platform''')
def file_hashes(root):
    out={}
    for p in sorted(root.rglob('''*''')):
        if p.is_file():
            h=hashlib.sha256(); f=p.open('''rb''')
            for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''''''): h.update(block)
            f.close(); out[str(p.relative_to(root))]=h.hexdigest()
    return out
checkpoint_same=file_hashes(gpu_root/'''checkpoints''')==file_hashes(cpu_root/'''checkpoints''')
if not checkpoint_same: differences.append('''checkpoint_hashes''')
result={'''schema''':'''r04.gpu_equivalence_pilot.v1''','''status''':'''PASS''' if not differences else '''FAIL''','''rtol''':rtol,'''atol''':atol,'''differences''':differences,'''max_abs''':max_abs,'''max_rel''':max_rel,'''checkpoint_files_equal''':checkpoint_same,'''gpu_execution_mode''':gpu.get('''fit_diagnostics''',{}).get('''execution_mode'''),'''cpu_execution_mode''':cpu.get('''fit_diagnostics''',{}).get('''execution_mode'''),'''gpu_inference_execution_mode''':gpu.get('''inference_diagnostics''',{}).get('''execution_mode'''),'''cpu_inference_execution_mode''':cpu.get('''inference_diagnostics''',{}).get('''execution_mode''')}
Path('''/home/huyudi/013_spatial/remote_outputs/pilot_r2_k0_f0_comparison_20260831.json''').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'''\n''')
if result['''status''']!='''PASS''': raise SystemExit(3)")'
